inSoulwind.label: Soulwind
inSoulwind.reason: His Skill gives Soulwind to the active character, a buff meant for the Physical carry he switches to.

a1DetectorStacks.label: Detector stacks
a1DetectorStacks.reason: Stacks of Soulwind that need more than one enemy hit, his Skill's shards and a crit from a character in both his Burst and Soulwind, so they build up during the fight; it needs the Soulwind switch as well.

c6Crit.label: Constellation 6 Physical CRIT DMG
c6Crit.reason: A Constellation 6 bonus of Soulwind, a buff meant for the active character he switches to; it needs the Soulwind switch as well.
